bio.title: Bio
bio.introduction: My name is Adrián Sotés, hence A S, to end up in 'A ese!' Because I want you to choose me to work together on your projects. I am a content creator, junior full stack web developer, and an expert in gamification.
bio.career: I have dedicated a large part of my professional career to developing virtual communities. I have a degree in Audiovisual Communication. My desire to continue growing professionally in all kinds of creative areas has led me to study design, community management, sound, modern harmony, and now, programming and web development.
bio.goal: My goal is to understand all the profiles from which to approach the development of content; thus, achieving functionality for the purpose for which it has been designed: a company's business plan, art, entertainment... The motivations are infinite. What is yours?
